sources.released_version_or_commit: OAI-PMH 2.0, released 2002-06-14; current official specification page.
sources.locator: Sections 2.5.1 (Deleted records), 3.3.2 (UTC datestamps), 3.4 (metadataPrefix), and 3.5 (flow control/resumption tokens).

sources.observed_operation: Read the official protocol text through web retrieval; no collection endpoint was queried.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Identify declares deletedRecord as no, transient, or persistent. With no deletion tracking, incremental harvesters cannot discover vanished records. Persistent means deletion records are retained consistently; transient gives no persistence guarantee. Date granularity and request ranges must follow the repository declaration; oai_dc is the required unqualified Dublin Core format.
sources.applicability: For any OAI-PMH connector, store the Identify response, granularity, set and metadataPrefix; handle resumption tokens; never assume silent absence means delete. Decide whether to tombstone only explicit deletions or to reconcile full snapshots.

For each pilot connector, retain change evidence and review zero/invalid deletion counts rather than silently publishing stale records.
